services.name: Culinary Training Program
services.desc: If you are interested in APPLYING to the Root Culinary Training Program, please fill out the Application by clicking on the button below. If you have questions about the Root Culinary Training Program, please email the Program Team. A 14-week culinary training program that combines hands-on food service training with workforce readiness skills. Trainees work with a professional chef every day, develop communication skills, learn about the restaurant industry, receive one-on-one job coaching, complete an externship at a local restaurant/food business, attend field trips, meet with a variety of industry professionals, and build personal finance skills.
